context.objective: Document how we carry out Financial Statement Creation, Review & Tie-Out, the controls and what needs confirmation.

turns.text: What starts this work?
It starts when the quarterly close reaches the financial-statement stage and the general ledger, trial balance, lead sheets and workbook are available.
Talk me through how you use those materials to create the financial statements.
I export the trial balance from the general ledger, link the statement lines to it in the Excel workbook, and then populate the Word statements from that workbook.
How do you determine which trial-balance accounts map to each statement line?
The exact mapping is specific to each fund and its package.
How is each fund’s package-specific mapping captured in the workbook?
The statement lines on the build tab are linked to the TB tab, unless a detailed schedule is designed to link to a lead sheet instead.
What determines whether a detailed schedule links to a lead sheet instead of the TB tab?
It depends on how the schedule is designed, for example an investment schedule links to a lead sheet.
What guides the fund-specific account mappings in each package?
I don't know of anything that guides it beyond it being specific to each fund and package.
What do you check in the Word statements against the workbook?
Every amount displayed in the Word statements has to trace to the reconciled workbook.
How do you verify that each Word statement amount traces to the reconciled workbook?
I convert the trial balance and the statements to PDF and mark each statement line with red checks and cross-references.
When you mark the PDF statements with red checks and cross-references, what do you compare each line against to confirm it traces to the reconciled workbook?
Cash ties to the trial balance, investment cost and fair value to the Schedule of Investments, and contributions and distributions to the schedule labeled M-1.
What makes the workbook reconciled and ready to use for the statement tie-out?
Each lead-sheet total ties exactly to its TB line and the check sheet has no unresolved mismatches.
What happens when a statement amount does not trace to its source?
I investigate, correct it and rerun the affected ties, and any difference I can't resolve is escalated to the Controller.
While an unresolved difference is with the Controller, what happens to the financial statements?
They can't be finalized until the difference is resolved.
What does the Controller do when you escalate an unresolved difference?
The Controller decides on it and returns it to me for correction.
After you make the Controller’s requested correction, what confirms the difference is resolved?
I rerun the affected ties until they agree exactly and keep the resolution note.
Who receives the financial statements after the tie-out is complete?
